name: 3way
description: An attributed three-party exchange with verifiable human commitments, built on WebMCP.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run site
scripts.deploy: npm run site && wrangler pages deploy dist-site && npm run deploy -w worker
scripts.typecheck:worker: if [ -d worker/src ]; then tsc -p worker --noEmit; else echo 'typecheck: worker sources are absent — skipping'; fi
scripts.preview: npm run site && npx --yes serve dist-site -l 4173
scripts.preview:local: npm run site:local && npx --yes serve dist-site -l 4173
